item.title: Podcow Oilers and NHL Daily: Thursday, September 17, 2026
item.description: As NHL training camps get underway, excitement builds in Edmonton with the Oilers entering peak hype season. Meanwhile, new Vancouver Canucks head coach Manny Malhotra set an intense physical tone by outskating his roster during day one bag skates. Across the league, current top overall picks offered their thoughts on highly anticipated prospect Gavin McKenna.
